item.description:
Release v5.23.0

Changes since v5.22.3

  • feat: add complete Lumi uninstall flow
  • feat: add diagnostic log export
  • feat(booklet-maker): add mobile session and reliable import (T2)
  • feat(booklet-maker): complete export result page with save and share (T7)
  • feat(booklet-maker): iPad layout, localization and polish (T8)
  • feat(booklet-maker): native parameters, binding effect and help (T6)
  • feat(booklet-maker): new root navigation, welcome screen and document overview (T3)
  • feat(booklet-maker): redesign booklet preview and original reading (T4)
  • feat(booklet-maker): rework split browsing, input and naming (T5)
  • feat(booklet-maker): UI tests, cleanup and delivery (T9)
  • feat(i18n): fix Onboarding UI localization
  • feat(tencent): expand TokenHub model catalog
  • feat(uninstall): add dedicated overlay for progress and result
  • feat(uninstall): simplify uninstall confirmation flow
  • fix: isolate debug and release uninstall data
  • fix: prevent SwiftUI teardown crashes
  • fix(booklet-maker): exclude iOS Info.plist from copy resources
  • fix(booklet-maker): make export results and cancellation reliable (T1)
  • fix(i18n): resolve module bundle access issue in LumiApp
  • fix(kit-super-log): build valid iOS resource bundle
